inputs.note: cluster_tree is mask_condensed_tree(condensed_tree, condensed_tree.child >= n_points) applied to condense_tree(mst_to_linkage_tree(sorted_mst), min_cluster_size=5) built from a real hierarchical-blobs dataset (2-3 super-clusters each with 2-4 sub-clusters, RandomState(45) recipe -- see condense_tree_seed45 fixture for the full condensed_tree this was masked from, and the 'data' field there for the raw points). n_nodes = cluster_tree.child[-1] - n_points + 1. Iterates row-PAIRS in reverse (idx = n_rows-1, n_rows-3, ...) -- cluster_tree rows come in adjacent left/right sibling pairs from condense_tree's branch-split output; out_idx = cluster_tree.child[idx] - n_points indexes the RIGHT sibling of the pair, out_idx-1 the LEFT. lambda_deaths uses exp(-1/lambda_val) -- lambda_val is never 0 here (guaranteed by condense_tree's lambda=1/d convention), but guard for it if porting to a context where it could be.
